slots.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

slots.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

slots.title: No agenda, no rush, no leaving San Francisco: Benchmark’s partners on investing in a frenzied market

slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.
